explanation: Magnesium burns in oxygen with a dazzling white flame to form magnesium oxide — the reaction NCERT uses to introduce what counts as a chemical reaction in the first place.

beaker_view.final_appearance: A soft white ash of magnesium oxide.

thermal.visual_cue: Burns with a dazzling white flame, too bright to look at directly.

beaker_view.observation: The ribbon catches and burns with an intensely bright white flame, leaving behind a soft white ash.
